notes: Posted 17 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards are marked '(start)' in the list rather than in a separate section: the Objective, 'Outer Walkway', Secret Plans, Imperial Arrest Order and I'm Sorry, plus There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement '(usually start)'; Prepared Defenses is listed under Interrupts. All count toward the 60. The strategy says to start Crush The Rebellion instead of There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement against Watch Your Step.

Posted 'Outer Walkway (start)' is kept as written: no Cloud City card has that name, and more than one Dark Cloud City walkway site fits (best guess: Cloud City: Upper Walkway, a Dark Cloud City battleground site the Objective could deploy).

Posted 'This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / You don t flip, it doesn t matter' dested This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (the second half is the poster's joke).
Posted 'Cloud City docking bay' dested the Dark Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) (Platform 327 is the Light site); 'Bespin', 'Carbonite Chamber' and 'West Gallery' dested the Dark pages.

Posted 'Darth Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Captain Bewill' Captain Bewil; 'Dreadnaught' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Prepared Defences' Prepared Defenses; 'Twilek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Weapon Levitation' the Dark Cloud City interrupt.
Posted 'Oppressive & There is No Try' dested There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; Secret Plans and I'm Sorry are the 2001 Effects (not the later shield / Virtual pages).
Posted 'Vader s Saber' dested Vader's Lightsaber (Premiere); 'Mara s Saber' Mara Jade's Lightsaber; 'Maul s Saber' Maul's Lightsaber (Tatooine; the double-bladed Reflections III saber came later).
